title: Motorcycle/scooter parking, more than 20 dwellings: 0.1 bays per dwelling (Table 3.9)
text: Table 3.9 Motorcycle/scooter parking (2): Developments exceeding 20 dwellings to provide 0.1 motorcycle/scooter bays per dwelling. (2) For each five motorcycle/scooter parking bays provided in accordance with Table 3.9, car parking bays may be reduced by one bay.

replaces.note: 1 motorcycle space per 10 car bays -> 0.1 per dwelling over 20 dwellings

notes: from: ch4p1 C2.3.3. Rate decoupled from car bays. verify: footnote 1 (rounding up) is attached to the car and bicycle rows, not this row; rounding up applied by analogy. Footnote 2 not encoded (no resident minimum to reduce; C4P2-103).

verified.note: p46 footnote 1 (round up) is marked on the resident car, visitor car and bicycle rows only; the motorcycle/scooter row carries footnote 2 alone.
